newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander sets structure in Mexican banking.
newsitem.headline: Santander sets structure in Mexican banking.

text.p: Spanish bank Grupo Santander said on Friday that the boards of its Grupo Financiero Invermexico and Banco Mexicano agreed a new structure that will be implemented on the merger with Grupo Santander Mexico.
The group is formed by two entities, Banco Santander Mexicano and Santander Investment.
The first, under the leadership of Juan Arenado, will handle commercial banking, consumer loans, corporate and international bank and insurance.

Santander Investment, under Miguel Alvarez, will be responsible for all the institutional relations of Grupo Santander Mexico and will centre its activities in the capital and money markets, investment banking and corporate finance among other.
Commerical banking formerly carried out by Banco Santander de Negocios will pass now to Banco Santander Mexicano.
Santander announced the purchase of Grupo Financiero Invermexico and Banco Mexicano last October for $425 million.
